title: VTG Playboy Magazine April 1986 Terri Weigel Playmate Complete With Centerfold
descriptionText: The product is a vintage April 1986 issue of Playboy Magazine featuring Terri Weigel as the Playmate. This edition comes complete with the centerfold intact, adding to its collectible value for fans of vintage nudes and modeling topics. The magazine is in English and follows a monthly publication frequency, making it a sought-after piece for collectors and enthusiasts of retro Playboy magazines.
